# SSD Scope for Mac

The Rust capture, validation and decoding modules are derived from [SSD Scope for Mac](https://github.com/ChakkritGit/SSD-Scope-for-Mac/tree/59311aa761a429121f4b165b02af36ac8d01aabf), MIT licensed. DeviceBridge restricts capture to the tested USB bridge (152d:0580) and uses a dedicated CLI. libusb and smartmontools are separately linked or executed and retain their own licenses and source.
